subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Is the WebChat transcript-notice fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95154 sufficient to resolve this issue, or should this issue require stronger no-loss restart recovery before closing?
rationale: The current bug is clear, but the issue offers several acceptable directions and the open PR fixes the user notice gap without preventing loss of the interrupted turn.

options.title: Accept focused notice fallback
options.body: Land a reviewed version of the linked PR so WebChat users see the existing unresumable notice after restart, then track stronger no-loss recovery separately if needed.

options.title: Require no-loss recovery here
options.body: Keep this issue open until inbound user messages are persisted or restart deferral reliably prevents interrupting active WebChat turns.

options.title: Split the scope
options.body: Use the linked PR for the notice gap and open separate canonical issues for restart deferral, immediate inbound persistence, and the daily WebChat reset-policy observation.

recommendation.title: Accept focused notice fallback
recommendation.body: Land a reviewed version of the linked PR so WebChat users see the existing unresumable notice after restart, then track stronger no-loss recovery separately if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent main/release history places the recovery and restart code under Vincent Koc's recent changes, making him the best available routing candidate for the product-boundary choice.
